original_finding_content.subject: Anfernee — Singapore-based solopreneur earning 90% of income from Gumroad digital products. Has 35,000 email subscribers on Gumroad. Products have sold thousands of copies. Started by launching one product per week for a year (56 total). Source: https://natashatynes.substack.com/p/what-i-learned-from-a-digital-products — Source page verified, but the specific revenue claims (90% of income, 35K subscribers) were reported as spoken quotes within the article; exact verbatim for these data points not independently confirmed character-for-character.
